name: @barqel/barq-events
description: Zero-dependency, typed asynchronous event bus and dispatcher for Barq

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --external @barqel/barq --target=node --format=esm --sourcemap=external --outdir dist && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --outDir dist
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run check && bun test && bun run build
